craft.body:
The Gorillaz dropouts were found by recording the RF picture over time, not by staring at a scan during soundcheck. Interference between IEM and mic transmitters often appears only at one stage position or one moment in the show, when packs and transmitters line up. Start every show with your scanner or coordination software logging, and note cue times when you hear a problem, so you can line them up afterwards.

Keep IEM transmitters and their antennas well away from mic receive antennas, and treat the IEM bands as part of the coordination, not something you add at the end. When a problem appears, change one thing at a time and keep the log running so you can prove the fix.
craft.title: Log your RF before you chase it
